text: Prior to City Council adjourning for the 2014 Municipal Election, I tabled a Notice of Motion that was unanimously approved by City Council, whereby a request was initiated to review the process to create a Dog Off-Leash Area near S.A.D.R.A. Park or alternatively along the Hydro Lands that are in close proximity. However, no report has been brought before City Council to date. Here is the link to the Motion that was approved with the stipulated direction at that time: https://www.toronto.ca/legdocs/mmis/2014/mm/bgrd/backgroundfile-72894.pdf S.A.D.R.A. Park was created by the community coming together in a determined effort, to clean up a barren Hydro-One corridor that was once overrun by drug dealers and other unlawful users. It needed to be cleaned up and revitalized; that was a decade ago. Ever since, we added some playground amenities, improved lighting and other passive uses, which…

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to re-affirm support for and initiate the process towards creating a Dog Off-Leash Area within S.A.D.R.A Park or along the Hydro Lands and to report back within the first quarter of 2019 on an implementation strategy in consultation with the local Ward Councillor. 2. City Council request the Director, Community Planning, Etobicoke-York District and the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, in consultation with the Ward Councillor, to prioritize the Section 42 Cash-In-Lieu allocation towards the creation of a Dog-Off Leash Area within S.A.D.R.A. Park or the Hydro Lands, along with additional community benefits within S.A.D.R.A. Park, including, but not limited to a new splash pad, playground enhancements and other aesthetic…
